title: Disney Parks Sketchbook Mickey Mouse Holiday Winter Mug - Used
descriptionText:
Basically new. Hardly used.

This Disney Parks Sketchbook Mickey Mouse Coffee Mug is the perfect addition to any Disney fan's collection. Featuring Mickey Mouse in his holiday winter outfit, this mug is perfect for enjoying your favorite hot beverage during the winter months. Made in 2021, this mug is a contemporary piece and is part of the Disney Winter convention/event.

The mug is designed with the beloved character Mickey Mouse and is a must-have for any fan of the franchise. It is a standard size mug and is made for coffee or tea. The mug is not modified and is an authentic Disney product. Add this mug to your collection of Disneyana or collectibles and enjoy the winter months in style with this festive Mickey Mouse mug.
